Aspect Model certificate of analysis

urn:samm:io.catenax.certificate_of_analysis:2.0.0#CertificateOfAnalysis

This page provides a lightweight, in-browser preview of the model. Use the interactive diagram (pan + zoom) to understand the overall structure. The sidebar contains the full structure tree. For advanced navigation (smart search, drag, deep details), open the dedicated viewer.

Tip: Use the mouse wheel (or trackpad) to zoom. Drag to pan. Double-click to reset.
The Certificate of Analysis documents the material (e.g. chemical compound) properties describing a material's quality or performance factors specific to manufacturing batch. The exact material properties depend on the material type and the following manufacturing processes. They are defined bilaterally between a supplier (manufacturer) and customer.

Entities

Site Entity

Describes the ID and function of a site for the associated part in the AsBuilt context(e.g. SerialPart, Batch, jIS).

Properties

site identifier

The identifier of the site according to BPDM. The siteId must be a valid BPN. The BPN is a unique, unchangeable identifier for Business Partners / company locations from foundation to closure, regardless of the different business relationships / structures between or within the Business Partners or company locations.

siteId
Characteristic
Trait

Optional
No

Yes

disclaimer entity

Legal protective framework that clarifies the certificate's informational scope versus contractual obligations, defining where analytical data ends and product suitability responsibility begins.

Properties

disclaimer metadata

A set of data describing the characteristics and context of the disclaimer within a document. It includes information about its origin, purpose, language, version, scope of validity and relationship with the main document. This metadata allows the disclaimer to be identified and managed as a traceable and reusable element within the document system.
Name
disclaimerMetadata
Characteristic
Type http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string
Example
This is a computer-generated document. A signature is not required.
Optional
Yes
In payload
Yes
Payload key
disclaimerMetadata
disclaimer requirement

Criteria or specifications that define the expected quality of a product or service. They serve as a basis for assessing conformity and ensuring that the product complies with agreed standards or technical specifications.
Name
disclaimerRequirement
Characteristic
Type http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string
Example
The above information describes the relevant parameters of the product at the time of issuance of this certificate of analysis. The data are regularly checked as part of our quality assurance and are provided for reference purposes only. The contractual quality of the product at the time of transfer of risk is determined solely by our product specification. Unless the parties have expressly agreed otherwise in writing and signed by authorized representatives, no suitability of the product for any particular purpose is assumed or implied. The customer is solely responsible for verifying the suitability of the product for any specific use.
Optional
Yes
In payload
Yes
Payload key
disclaimerRequirement

sites

A site is a delimited geographical area where a legal entity does business(geographical address with geo coordinates).A site always has a primary physical address. It is possible that further physical addresses are specified for the site. P.O. box details are only possible in addition to the physical address. A site has a 1:n relation to addresses, means at least 1 address is necessary and multiple addresses are possible.

material property

A material property with its name, definition measured value and specification (limits). If available, lower limit and upper limit must be given, they are only optional in the case that the limits don't exist or don't apply.

Properties

The name of the property.

Characteristic
Type http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string
Example

No
In payload

This field should be used to describe the property.

If available a reference to a public or internal norm should be provided. The norm should specify the meaning of the property as well as the specification of the analysis method used.

data space identifier

The fully anonymous ID in the dataspace of the part.
Name
globalAssetId
Characteristic
Trait
Reference
  • https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4122
Type http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string
Optional
Yes
In payload
Yes
Payload key
globalAssetId
Constraints
  • UUID v4 Regular Expression
    Description
    The provided regular expression ensures that the UUID is composed of five groups of characters separated by hyphens, in the form 8-4-4-4-12 for a total of 36 characters (32 hexadecimal characters and 4 hyphens), optionally prefixed by "urn:uuid:" to make it an IRI.
    Reference
    • https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4122
    Regular expression
    (^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$)|(^urn:uuid:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$)
